title: The Mighty, Righteous, Risen
content:
Intro: [6m] [5] [4] [3] [5][*Repeat two times]
Verse 1: 
He is [6m]mighty oh [5]mighty His [4]majesty displayed in [3]all the things He’s [5]made
He is [6m]mighty oh [5]mighty His [4]majesty displayed in [3]the birds and rocks shall [5]praise
Chorus 1: 
The God of [1]gods, the King of [6m]kings, the Lord of [5]lords Creator [4]of all things [1]He is [5]good
He's the God of [1]gods, the King of [6m]kings, the Lord of [5]lords
Be glori[4]fied here Lord [1]as we [5]sing Your praise[*to Intro]
Intro: 
Verse 2: 
He is [6m]righteous oh [5]righteous His [4]sent His only Son, [3]sin He did bec[5]ome
But now He's [6m]risen, oh [5]risen [4]risen from the grave His [3]children stand to [5]praise
Chorus 2: 
The God of [1]gods, the King of [6m]kings, the Lord of [5]lords Resc[4]uer of our [1]souls we [5]sing
He's the God of [1]gods, the King of [6m]kings, the Lord of [5]lords
Be glori[4]fied here Lord [1]as we [5]sing Your praise[*to bridge]
Bridge 1: [6m]  [5]  [4]  [5][*Play two times]
[6m]We sing be[5]cause You are w[4]orthy,  [5]   [6m] worthy [5]of our [4]praise  [5]
[6m]We sing be[5]cause of Your g[4]lory Lord,[5]   [6m]Your glory [5]fills this [4]place
Your [2m]children stand to [b3]praise
Tag 1: 
Your [6m]name! Oh, Your [5]name! The [4]Name above all names, w[3]orthy to be pr[5]aised!
Outro:[6m] [5] [4] [3] [5][*Repeat two times]
